risks: A two-edge RS DAG hides eleven explicit architecture prerequisites, transitive RS-ADM-01 and live-provider/calendar/export contracts. Accepted predecessor receipts alone do not prove every gate.

Published source references pin older 249b3b44220bcfbd7d467de9cfc18f76e1c37807; current inspected Notes save is at 1023-1099, not cited historical 858-904. Working-tree whole-file hashes must be rechecked after root integration; preflight is not an input-HEAD runtime receipt.

Canonical Help Desk target/service files are not present now. Creating a local Ticket store, KB body store, scheduler, notification service or isolated screen to bypass those prerequisites violates scope.
Calendar/DST/timezone/reopen semantics need explicit accepted contract, not arbitrary math. Prospective publishing versus audited recalculation must preserve historical breaches and rule provenance.

Notes side-session revisionByEntityId currently uses updatedAt and prefill allow-all context. Neither proves canonical revision/export authorization; using it as customer citation provenance could disclose private source text.
Tool schemas/dedup/MCP lens are advertisement mechanisms, not authorization. Drafting must not call another reply path or extend ownership/grants.

Existing Inbox optional RPC empty fallbacks and local firstSeen/done/snooze state must not be adopted as backend availability, SLA event dedup or milestone lifecycle evidence. Attention errors/loaded gate/revoke/counts need coherent shared integration.
Provider accepted is not readback. Duplicate/replayed/late provider events or stale deadline generations must not produce multiple milestone closures or breach notifications.

Multiple packages share Notes/Pages/Inbox/routes/agent definitions/contracts/migrations/transport/locales. Single-owner serialized patch application and post-wave0 re-read are required; no shared edits were made here.
Native/provider lanes, negative mutants and independent review remain mandatory. An accepted JSON/schema report, screenshots alone or a narrowed green test cannot make this feature complete.
